build.buildCommand: rm -rf .next/cache/webpack && npm run build && echo '[BUILD-DEBUG] app-build-manifest:' && node -e "const f='.next/app-build-manifest.json';if(!require('fs').existsSync(f)){console.log('FILE NOT FOUND');process.exit(0);}const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'));const pages=m.pages||m;const keys=Object.keys(pages);console.log('Page keys:',keys.length);const cssKeys=keys.filter(k=>pages[k]&&pages[k].some&&pages[k].some(v=>v.includes('.css')));console.log('Keys with CSS:',cssKeys.length,cssKeys.slice(0,5));const layoutKey=keys.find(k=>k.includes('layout'));console.log('Layout key:',layoutKey,layoutKey?JSON.stringify(pages[layoutKey]).slice(0,300):'N/A');" 2>&1 || true

deploy.startCommand: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run start
